name: Guardian cryptic crossword, Penguin book 5 No 50
preamble: Solve the clues and fit the solutions into the diagram jigsaw-wise, wherever they will go.

clue.text: Put a parson up to make assertion
Currency for balancing ref's version
Partridges for chap with last of honey
Sounds sans matter: cry reform in money
Once round North-East, for importance noted
Bits of verse with which deserters voted
Social state, not mildness, he'll be boasting
Mate of seeing eye: hare off, not coasting
Half resign 'ulled maize — it's far from glory
Leftist with a change of heart is Tory
Train: for king I left a Czech romancer
Ends in row on ship, and sloth's the answer
Go — my aim's caused anti-union feeling
Born and died, necessity revealing
Seems America's responsibility
Puce — and flea's its source, that loves tranquillity
Oddly odd tin plate in wharf's imprisoned
Spain's club stunner: is but isn't
Turkish Shire went down around Jamaica
Spellbound state, perhaps, of Cretan faker
Not in Book, has Puritan curls shaken
Coat of G in J toast cooked his bacon …
Who from Holland half a crown had taken
and same with 3 F to make Scots refractory
Eagle-like, you're in ex 3 F's factory
Woolly (?) hunter with a grey entangled
Last, first, last in jest, alternate-angled
